name: r1-oproj-e1-baseline-id
author: solx-loop
description: E1 (tests H11): the code is r0, unchanged. The session timed PyTorch-only candidates under harness CUPTI timing on the rented B200. No candidate that includes the residual add reaches Tb. Tb divided by a plain cuBLAS matmul alone (no add) is flat at 1.18-1.26 (spread 7%) over all 10 sizes. So Tb behaves like plain-GEMM speed times about 1.22, which is the portal/rented factor for plain cuBLAS GEMMs. To beat Tb, a kernel must fuse the residual at plain-GEMM speed (H10).
